summary: Explains why a view has no content yet and invites the action that fills it. An empty screen is a starting point, not a dead end.

p.title: No pull requests yet
p.description: Changes you sync from Figma open a pull request here, ready for review.

whenToUse: First use: nothing has been created yet (no tokens, no pull requests). Explain the value and offer the first step.
No results: a search or filter matched nothing. Say what was searched and how to widen it.
Cleared: the user finished everything (no reviews waiting). Confirm it calmly.
size sm inside tables and cards, md in panels, lg for a whole page.
whenNotToUse: Errors that stopped content from loading: use an Alert with a retry action.

dos.title: Say what goes here and how to get it
dos.text: The title names the missing object, the description says where it comes from, the button starts it.

p.title: No pull requests yet
p.description: Changes you sync from Figma open a pull request here.

donts.title: "Nothing here" with no way forward
donts.text: It describes the screen the user already sees and leaves them stuck.

accessibility: The title is a real heading (headingLevel, default h3) so it appears in the page outline; pick the level that fits the page.
The icon is decorative and hidden from assistive tech: the title carries the meaning.
Actions are regular Buttons or Links in the tab order, after the text.
contentGuidelines: Title: what is missing, plainly: "No tokens match brand.700".
Description: why it is empty and what fills it, in one or two sentences.
One primary action at most, named with a verb: "Sync from Figma".
No jokes or illustrations that delay the next step.
